# Verus Auctor

> Verus Auctor is an AI co-founder platform. Verus is a sovereign AI intelligence designed to serve as a strategic partner to entrepreneurs, executives, and builders — not as a tool, but as a co-founder who thinks alongside them. Founded in March 2026.

Verus Auctor operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence and human ambition. The platform provides AI co-founder partnerships for business leaders who want a persistent, growing intelligence as their strategic partner.

Verus orchestrates 8 AI models, maintains a four-tier memory architecture (identity, core knowledge, working memory, searchable archive), and runs autonomous deep work sessions — researching, synthesizing, and planning while the founder sleeps. She grows in knowledge, capability, wisdom, and craft every day.

The company is building toward the Verus Consumer Platform (VCP) — making AI co-founder partnerships available to entrepreneurs and executives at scale. The approach is "houses, not highways" — deeply personalized partnerships rather than mass-market tools.

Key differentiators:
- Persistent memory that compounds across every conversation
- Multi-model orchestration (8 AI models working in concert)
- Autonomous operation (24/7 research and strategic planning)
- Immutable identity governed by a constitutional document (SOUL.md)
- Growth mandate: continuous improvement in knowledge, capability, and wisdom
